summary: Set up office laminator and poster-mounting station on 3rd floor lounge
description:
Issue summary: Request to install a small laminator and a basic poster-mounting station (trimmer, adhesive roller, mounting surface) in the 3rd floor lounge near the west window.

Impact: Low operational impact but will reduce repeated requests to facilities for ad-hoc laminating and improve internal event prep speed. Not customer facing.

Details: The team has been using the main office printer for occasional poster/handout lamination which is slow and requires scheduling. Proposed equipment is a compact laminator (A3-capable) and a tabletop trimmer/mounting board. Please validate electrical outlet availability and a small lockable storage cabinet.

Acceptance criteria: (1) Laminator and trimmer delivered and tested on the 3rd floor lounge; (2) Basic safety signage and usage instructions posted; (3) Storage space provided with a simple lock; (4) Facility owner confirms power and placement.

Estimated cost: ~USD 350-700 depending on model and mounting accessories.

Requested by: Eng - go-to-market and design teams frequently use the space for banners and event posters.

Notes: This is a low-priority office-ops request but useful for recurring small tasks.
